question: Graft versus host disease begins when:

options.opa: The regulatory T lymphocytes present in the graft sample react against host antigens by killing their cells.
options.opb: Mature T lymphocytes present in the graft sample react against host antigens.
options.opc: Neutrophils present in the graft sample react against host antigens by killing their cells.
options.opd: The mature T lymphocytes of the graft react against the antigens of the transplanted organ.
